challenges.finding: Catalog VBA shares its grammar scope and several extensions with VB6. VB6 catalog aliases include broader Classic labels. The two exact .Dsr witnesses plus Microsoft's product versus successor contrast anchor the edition referent. Any universal extension, whole classifier sample population, alias equivalence or code compatibility claim remains open.
